---
title: "Research"
---

My research sits at the intersection of gravitation, black-hole physics, quantum field theory, holography and quantum information.

<div class="grid-cards research-overview">
<div class="card-clean"><h3>Black holes</h3><p>Black-hole solutions and dynamics, regular geometries, collapse, interiors, extremality and singularities.</p></div>
<div class="card-clean"><h3>Higher-curvature gravity</h3><p>Higher-derivative extensions of General Relativity, especially Einsteinian cubic gravity and the (generalized) quasi-topological gravities that we developed.</p></div>
<div class="card-clean"><h3>Entanglement in quantum field theory</h3><p>Universal entanglement structures and constraints, quantum field theory from entanglement, and entanglement measures.</p></div>
<div class="card-clean"><h3>Holography and quantum gravity</h3><p>Holographic entanglement, quantum aspects of spacetime, generalized symmetries, and gravity from entanglement.</p></div>
</div>
